research_question: What is the effect of probiotics compared with placebo or no treatment on kidney function, measured as serum creatinine, at 8 to 24 weeks in people with chronic kidney disease?
outcome_description: Serum creatinine at 8 to 24 weeks post-baseline, expressed in mg/dL (converted from µmol/L where necessary). Extracted as mean, standard deviation, and sample size per arm at end of treatment or as mean change from baseline.
positive_direction: Lower serum creatinine in the probiotic group compared to the control group (indicating better preserved renal function and favouring probiotics).
search_queries: probiotics chronic kidney disease randomized trial serum creatinine
probiotic supplementation kidney function controlled trial
probiotics hemodialysis diabetic nephropathy trial creatinine
inclusion_criteria: Randomised controlled trials evaluating probiotics (single- or multi-strain supplements, or probiotic-containing foods) versus placebo or no treatment in people with chronic kidney disease of any stage (including diabetic nephropathy and dialysis).
Intervention duration of approximately 8 to 24 weeks reporting quantitative serum creatinine outcomes at follow-up or change from baseline.
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, review articles, editorials, opinion pieces, animal studies, or in vitro models).

No comparison between a probiotic condition and an inactive control (e.g. studies evaluating prebiotics alone, synbiotics, or head-to-head comparisons between two probiotic regimens without a control arm).
No quantitative outcome data that can produce an effect size for serum creatinine (e.g., missing means, standard deviations, or convertible measures of dispersion).
Conducted in populations without chronic kidney disease or completely unrelated to the research topic.
moderators_to_extract: CKD stage / modality (non-dialysis CKD vs hemodialysis vs peritoneal dialysis)
Probiotic format (capsule/tablet supplement vs probiotic food/dairy/honey)
Outcome data type (end-of-treatment absolute value vs change score)
effect_size_note: Pool as mean difference (MD) in mg/dL using a random-effects model. Negative MD indicates lower serum creatinine in the probiotic group relative to control. Convert µmol/L to mg/dL (divide by 88.4). Convert SE/SEM to SD via SD = SE × √n. Prioritise end-of-treatment values; if unavailable, use change-from-baseline values. Combine multiple probiotic arms where applicable.
